name: Methane (CH4) Tetrahedral Molecule
semanticDescription: 3D ball-and-stick covalent molecular model of methane (CH4) exhibiting perfect tetrahedral geometry with four equivalent C-H single covalent bonds at 109.5 degree bond angles, alongside an sp3-1s covalent orbital overlap mode with plaque.
simplifications: Atoms represented by CPK color-coded spheres.
Covalent electron sharing represented by cylindrical chemical bond rods and directional orbital overlap lobes.
